messages:
Liza: Kickoff for NebulaWorks POC. They want nebula-14b-rlft (fine-tuned) for multi-turn support+search. Need onboarding checklist, perf numbers on 8k context, and provisional pricing. @Marco @Priya.
Marco: Quick scan: weights look q4_k_m 4-bit; custom BOS token but standard tokenizer. KV cache estimated ~12k per convo.
Priya: Perf notes: on V100-32GB single-stream ~80 tok/s; on A100-40GB with fused kernels ~300 tok/s. With batch=6 we measured ~1500 tok/s in internal sim. Latency warm ~50ms.
Terry: Infra: hosted can handle POC but EU residency requirement may push to a private staging node. Also need to validate q4_km fused kernel on our small-GPU fleet. If missing, fallback to nebula-14b-ptq-8 variant.
Liza: Pricing ask: mid-market POC, ~40k requests/month, avg 150 tokens/response. Need hosted vs dedicated delta and promo pricing for trial.
Marco: Rough hosted estimate: $0.0008/token generation promo; dedicated reserved estimate will be ~40% lower on token cost but has min commit. I'll run sim with their distribution.
Priya: Eval tasks: hallucination sweep and retrieval QA on a 5k query sample. I'll push results tomorrow morning. Also testing 8k vs 12k context for mem/throughput.
ops-bot: poc-template created: https://console.redwood.internal/pocs/nebula-14b
Liza: Security: they require SSO, audit logs, and basic encryption at rest; no KMS BYOK. We'll mark as standard.
Terry: Next actions:
- Priya: perf+eval on A100 + small-GPU, post numbers EOD
- Marco: cost sim and variant mapping (nebula-14b-ptq-8, nebula-7b-lite)
- Liza: draft POC SOW and send initial pricing tiers to account exec
- Terry: confirm EU staging availability and kernel compatibility
Liza: 15m sync tomorrow 9:30?
Priya: works for me.
Marco: will join.
Liza: adding invite. Keep updates here.
